Definition: Local (lab) reference identifier for the donor.
NIMP unique identifier for the donor.
Common name for the donor species (e.g. Mouse, Human)
NCBI Taxonomy ID for species; format ID with prefix 'NCBI:txid'
The genotype or transgenic line information (e.g. StrainName, CreDriverLine, ReporterName, etc.)
Local (lab) reference ID assigned to the organ/brain.
The component part of the nervous system where the tissue is found (e.g. brain, spinal cord)
Local unique ID that represents the tissue cryosection to be processed
NIMP ID for the tissue cryosection
Reference atlas used to pin locations
The (sub) location(s) or region where the tissue is found; structures from DHBA, MBA ontologies
Z position within the piece of tissue that the section comes from
Unique identifier that represents the chip/slide/coverslip that the tissue section was mounted on. Depending on platform, may be a local ID or provided by manufacturer.
